title: Component Type, Required DTSTART, Scalar Temporals, and RRULE Syntax Are Well-Formed

citations.verbatim_quote: The form of date and time with UTC offset MUST NOT be used. For example, the following is not valid for a DATE-TIME value: 19980119T230000-0800 ;Invalid time format

; The following is REQUIRED if the component ; appears in an iCalendar object that doesn't ; specify the "METHOD" property; otherwise, it ; is OPTIONAL; in any case, it MUST NOT occur ; more than once. ; dtstart /

The recurrence set is generated by considering the initial "DTSTART" property along with the "RRULE", "RDATE", and "EXDATE" properties contained within the recurring component. The "DTSTART" property defines the first instance in the recurrence set.

statement: Every calendar item has type VEVENT or VTODO; every VEVENT has DTSTART; every present DTSTART, DTEND, DUE, or RECURRENCE-ID parses as a valid RFC 5545 DATE or DATE-TIME without a bare fixed UTC offset; and every present RRULE has a valid DTSTART and parses as a valid RFC 5545 RECUR value.
rationale: RFC 5545 Section 3.6.1 requires DTSTART on every VEVENT in a METHOD-less calendar store, Section 3.3.5 forbids bare fixed-offset DATE-TIME values without TZID, and Section 3.8.5.3 requires DTSTART alongside RRULE. Enforcing syntactic validity directly prevents malformed strings from silently bypassing downstream invariants that skip unparsable values.
